translations.web_hero_subtitle: ONLANG helps sports clubs organise their communication in one place while easing the load on volunteers.
translations.web_warum_p1: Many clubs publish the same information several times – on the website, in the app, in the newsletter or on social media. That takes time volunteers often do not have.
translations.web_warum_p2: This is exactly where ONLANG comes in: a post is created in one place and appears wherever you decide.
translations.web_warum_claim: One post. Multiple channels. Less work.
translations.web_warum_row1: Write a post for the website
translations.web_warum_row2: Create the post again for the app
translations.web_warum_row3: Prepare the post yet again for other channels
translations.web_warum_row_final: With ONLANG: create once, tick the channels – done.
translations.web_loes_subtitle: Everything your club needs for modern digital communication, from a single source.
translations.web_loes_website_desc: Your modern club website – or an add-on to your existing website.
translations.web_loes_app_desc: Your club's own app for members, parents, players and fans.
translations.web_loes_studio_desc: The central platform for posts, drafts and scheduled publishing.
translations.web_loes_newsletter_desc: Club news automatically as a newsletter.
translations.web_loes_veranstaltungen_desc: Announce dates and events as a post – in the app and on the website.
translations.web_loes_sponsoren_desc: Digital visibility for your sponsors on website and app.
translations.web_loes_push_desc: Important information straight to your members' smartphones.
translations.web_loes_social_desc: Publish posts to Facebook and Instagram at the push of a button.
translations.web_loes_ki_desc: Match reports are created automatically from the scoresheet.
translations.web_flow_subtitle: One central input point – multiple communication channels.
translations.web_ref_subtitle: These clubs already rely on ONLANG.
translations.web_preise_subtitle: Transparent and fair – with a special founders' offer for the market launch.
translations.web_news_fallback_3: AI match reports live in testing
translations.web_ueber_p1: ONLANG grew out of more than 30 years of hands-on experience in sports club communication. We know the daily challenges of volunteer club work from our own experience.
translations.web_kontakt_subtitle: We show you ONLANG with no obligation and explain which options make sense for your club.
translations.web_footer_desc: ONLANG – the digital platform for sports clubs. Create once. Up to date everywhere.
translations.web_contact_pflichtfelder: Please fill in all required fields.

translations.app_team_password_hint: Please log in with your team password
translations.web_hero_claim: Create once. Up to date everywhere.
translations.web_loes_tv_desc: Your club's videos and match recordings in a channel of its own.
translations.web_loes_grafik_desc: Results, fixtures and tables turned into social media graphics in seconds. Event banners (coming soon).
translations.web_loes_presse_desc: Your content becomes press texts and publications.
translations.web_bestand_title: Already have a club website? No problem.
translations.web_bestand_p1: You do not have to replace your existing website. ONLANG complements it: with a simple embed, your ONLANG posts also appear on your current site.
translations.web_bestand_p2: Your website stays as it is – and you still manage your content centrally in ONLANG.
translations.web_fuerwen_p1: Whether a small department, an independent sports club or a large multi-sport club: ONLANG offers one shared digital platform for the whole club.
translations.web_fuerwen_p2: The price is per club – not per department and not per team.
translations.web_preis_basic_f1: Club website – or an embed in your existing website
translations.web_preis_basic_f2: Club app for members, parents and fans
translations.web_preis_pro_f3: Save posts as drafts and schedule them
translations.web_preis_pro_f4: Choose per post where it appears
translations.web_preis_pro_f8: Graphics generator for results, fixtures and tables
translations.web_preis_pro_f10: Social media at the push of a button (coming soon)
translations.web_preis_beide: Both plans: try free for 14 days – with the full PRO feature set.
translations.web_preis_proplus: Coming soon: PRO+ – a planned surprise for clubs with big plans.
translations.web_gruender_lead: The first 50 clubs secure the ONLANG founders' price.
translations.web_gruender_zeitraum: Registration from 1 November to 31 December 2026, while the 50 places last.
translations.web_gruender_dauerhaft: The founders' price applies permanently, as long as the club remains an ONLANG customer without interruption.
translations.web_gruender_pro_verein: Prices are per club – regardless of the number of departments or teams.
translations.web_test_p1: Try ONLANG free for 14 days with the full PRO feature set. Explore your club's app, website, Studio and Club TV.
translations.web_test_p2: You receive your trial access and can start right away: you add your club logo, welcome text, club colour, number of members and teams yourself in a few minutes. If you like, we help you set things up.
translations.web_test_p3: The trial can also run past the turn of the year. What counts for the founders' price is registering within the founders' period.
translations.web_ueber_p2: Our idea is simple: sports clubs should have more time for their sport and their members – and spend less time doing digital work twice.
translations.web_ueber_p3: That is why ONLANG brings website, app, Studio and club communication together in one shared platform.
